subject: coprocessor: ensure monotonicity of ranges (#64359)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on `pkg/store/copr`. The change defensively reorders non-monotonic `KeyRanges` before calling client-go `RegionCache.BatchLocateKeyRanges` (which assumes monotonic input and can otherwise skip/warp coverage), and disables range-aligned row hints when reordering to avoid misalignment. Added richer range logging/trace-event emission plus a small unit test. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in store/coprocessor correctness, consistency, concurrency, or request/response handling for this commit.
